steps.caption: Services
steps.narration: Services lists every service and category on this listing, as Google has them.

steps.caption: The count
steps.narration: The badge counts the services on the listing: fourteen here, all synced from Google.

steps.caption: Categories, primary marked
steps.narration: Categories come first, with the primary category marked: Roofing contractor here.

steps.caption: One service per row
steps.narration: Then each service, one per row: roof replacement, roof repair, hail damage repair, and on.

steps.caption: Search the list
steps.narration: When the list is long, type in the search to narrow it.

steps.caption: Edit them on Google
steps.narration: Change services or categories in Google Business Profile; the next sync brings them here.

steps.caption: Menu: Locations
steps.narration: You'll find Locations in the Google Business menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to see your services and categories from Google | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: The Services tab of a linked location in ConstructHUB: every category on the listing with the primary one marked, every service one per row, a count badge, and a search that narrows a long list. Services are read from Google on each sync; you edit them in Google Business Profile.
